overview: The Medford School Committee met to receive presentations on school discipline laws and special education performance ratings, approve policy manual updates and a legislative recognition resolution, and request reports on reading instruction and school discipline.

items.title: Executive Session on Collective Bargaining
items.summary: The committee convened in executive session to discuss strategy related to ongoing collective bargaining negotiations with multiple bargaining units.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Good of the Order
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda and discussed scheduling a committee goal-setting meeting as well as enhancing student representative participation.

items.title: Rules and Policy Subcommittee Report
items.summary: The committee accepted the November 16, 2022 subcommittee minutes detailing ongoing work to update district wellness and recess policies.

items.title: Superintendent's Report and Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented community updates, district athletic and drama achievements, Thanksgiving donation drive results, and upcoming school events.

items.title: Presentation on School Discipline Laws and Student Privacy
items.summary: Attorney Felicia Vasudevan provided an overview of state disciplinary statutes, local restorative practice policies, emergency removals, and student record privacy laws.

items.title: Special Education Determination Report
items.summary: Student Services Director Joan Bowen reported that Medford Public Schools earned a 78.3% score and a 'meets requirements' determination for IDEA Part B compliance for the 2022–2023 school year.

items.title: Labor Negotiations Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy reported that retroactive compensation payouts for settled bargaining unit agreements are being processed.

items.title: Policy ACAB Text Amendment
items.summary: The committee approved updating Policy ACAB to replace references to Columbus Elementary School with Missituk Elementary School.

items.title: Resolution Recognizing Representative Sean Garballey
items.summary: The committee passed a resolution recognizing State Representative Sean Garballey for his work sponsoring the MAI-CEI legislation expanding higher education access for students with disabilities.

items.title: Report Request on Reading Instruction Curriculum
items.summary: The committee approved a report request regarding district reading curricula, phonics instruction time, and the use of three-queuing instruction models.

items.title: Report Request on Suspension and Discipline
items.summary: The committee approved an amended report request seeking comprehensive data on student disciplinary actions across grade levels, subgroup disproportionality, and staff guidance training.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of William Matarazzo and Albert Panarisi.
